instructions: Read the primary source in full. A technically successful full-text fetch is not sufficient when tables, appendices, or other evidence needed for the five slots are missing; continue through the ordered official full-text routes and use the next route only to fill the missing primary evidence. selection_reason: DETAGは分散MoE推論におけるホットexpertの負荷偏りとノード間通信を抑える。必要に応じ複製する動的ホットexpertプールと、EMA平滑化負荷・通信トポロジー費用を同時考慮するjoint gatingを導入。複数GPUノードで既存MoE推論方式比最大2.54倍の高速化を報告。
title: Dynamic Hot Expert Replication with Load and Topology-Aware Joint Gating for Distributed MoE Inference
venue: International Workshop on Quality of Service
